name: Chat with Santa
tagline: Chat with Santa, Elf and Rudolph. Share a little wonder together, then turn Christmas wishes into a keepsake to share.
shortDescription: Festive chats with Santa, Elf and Rudolph, and Christmas wish lists to make and share.
longDescription: Bring a little North Pole wonder to family time. Message Santa, Elf and Rudolph, gather Christmas wishes from your conversations, and create a festive wish-list card to share.
